Mandatory requirement: The candidate should have either a PhD in the GenAI field or a strong research background in GenAI , including research areas related to GenAI approaches and risk areas such as security, privacy, and robustness, as well as significant prior exposure to GenAI tools and techniques. Main requirements: Deep expertise in full-stack Python, agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangSmith), Model Context Protocol (MCP), prompt engineering, context engineering, harness engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), large language models (LLMs), fine-tuning, and machine learning. Big plus: Deep knowledge of modern data stack technologies (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake) for pipeline integration and scalable deployment. As a Lead AI Engineer , you will architect, build, and deploy context-driven, production-ready AI solutions that transform how entire organizations work and deliver value. You’ll leverage the power of LLMs and next-gen AI agents to automate complex workflows, unleashing revolutionary productivity and efficiency. Your work will directly drive the adoption of autonomous AI agents, enabling smarter operations and seamless data pipelines. Core Responsibilities: Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data science, and engineering teams to scope, define, and translate complex business needs into technical AI requirements. Evaluate and select optimal technologies for cloud and on-premise deployments, implementing strategies for scalability, performance monitoring, and cost optimization. Architect, develop, and integrate scalable agentic AI solutions, including the backend infrastructure required for seamless end-to-end deployment. Implement testing, monitoring, and evaluation pipelines to continuously improve prompt effectiveness, context handling, and overall agent performance. Participate in code reviews, contribute to best practices, and mentor peers on AI automation technologies and frameworks. Technical Skills: Deep experience with full-stack Python development (FastAPI, Flask; SQL/NoSQL databases). Deep proficiency with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph and LangSmith, including prompt engineering, context engineering, harness engineering, MCP, RAG, large language models (LLMs), fine-tuning, and machine learning. Deep experience integrating AI agent solutions into production systems. Deep experience with cloud infrastructure, containerization (Docker), and CI/CD practices. Deep experience with AI-powered IDEs and tools such as Visual Studio, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cursor, etc. Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Years of experience: 5+ years of software engineering or data science experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying agentic AI solutions in production. As a Big Plus – Deep Data Science + LLM/GenAI Data Science Experience: Foundations in statistics and machine learning (probability, hypothesis testing, experimental design, bias/variance, regularization) and ability to translate ambiguous problems into measurable ML objectives. Experience building and validating predictive models end-to-end (feature engineering, training, cross-validation, model selection, error analysis) using tools like scikit-learn and XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost. Experience designing rigorous evaluation strategies: offline metrics, online experimentation (A/B tests), guardrails, and monitoring for drift/quality regressions. LLM evaluation experience: building automated and human-in-the-loop evals for generation quality (task success, relevance, factuality/faithfulness, toxicity/safety), and using frameworks/patterns like LLM-as-a-judge with calibration and consistency checks. RAG-focused data science: measuring retrieval quality (recall@k, MRR, nDCG), diagnosing chunking/embedding tradeoffs, query rewriting, reranking, and grounding/attribution quality. This role sits at the intersection of advertising technology, the creator economy, and generative AI — and you'll define the products that make live commerce accessible and irresistible to brands of all sizes. Your north star is brand adoption and retention. You'll own the product charter for Amazon Live's creator and brand tools — including AI-powered content creation, the Live Creator App, Brand Store live integrations, and brand-facing reporting and analytics. You'll define what we build, push the boundaries of generative AI for content creation, partner with engineering to ship at speed, and use data to deeply understand what drives brands to go live, stay active, and grow their investment. You'll also shape how brands connect with influencers through our platform, building features that make creator-brand collaboration seamless and measurable. You'll write the strategy documents, define the roadmap, make hard tradeoffs, and own what ships. You'll work in deep partnership with Amazon Ads, UX measurement and reporting, and engineering teams — translating complex advertiser needs into elegant, scalable product experiences. You'll be supported by a co-located engineering team, UX designers, and BI resources, and you'll have the autonomy to shape an emerging product category where the right product decisions directly move leadership goals. If you're a product leader who thinks in terms of customer problems, can toggle between long-term vision and sprint-level execution, and want to define how Amazon approaches live commerce for brands — this is your role. Key job responsibilities This candidate sits within Live’s B2B product team, and owns the product charter for the Amazon Live Creator App as well as other creator tools used by thousands of creators. The candidate is expected to work with GTM, content acquisition, BD & sales teams, as well as broader Amazon Ads and Creator orgs, to help setup our brand and influencer creators for success and deliver great live shopping experiences. They will be supported by a large engineering team, UX designers and Business Intelligence team. The right person would have experience defining long-term product strategy, enjoys being customer obsessed, has technical knowledge and is comfortable with a high-level of ambiguity. They would be equally comfortable ideating on the next set of content creation features with brands and partners, and in delivering those for millions of shoppers with our engineering team. They will craft and communicate a strategic roadmap and see to its execution. We move fast; and that allows PMs to deliver on a large impact in a short time frame. Our team actively invests in career growth, and we will work with you to chart a strong growth path forward. A day in the life You will craft your product strategy, and then bring it to reality. You are comfortable working on products with complex tradeoffs. You will deeply understand and socialize our evolving needs to our customers, with your content, marketing, BD and design partners. About the team Amazon Shopping Videos (ASV) is an exciting, strategic program that harnesses the power of video to help millions of customers discover product inspiration, learn about items they're interested in, and engage with talented creators and communities. We empower customers to effortlessly find relevant content and explore our library of product-focused videos throughout their entire shopping journey on Amazon. We are a dynamic, startup-like initiative within Amazon, aiming to reinvent the way customers use video to shop. To achieve this bold vision, we are seeking motivated, thoughtful self-starters who can forge effective partnerships across our multi-disciplinary teams to drive continuous innovation.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Applied AI Research Engineer

Applied AI Research Team, Applied AI

About the role:

As an Applied AI Research Engineer, you will discover what Anthropic's models and products can do, prove it with real customers, and equip the rest of Applied AI to sell and deliver it. You'll embed with product teams to build deep expertise on new capabilities as they develop, and serve as a critical feedback loop carrying field reality back to Product and Research so that what we build next reflects what customers actually need.

In collaboration with Sales, Product, and Research teams, you'll sit at the intersection of what we build and how customers adopt it. You'll own the technical<> GTM handshake for model and product launches: testing new models to understand their strengths and limitations, building demos and evals, and helping field teams get ready. When strategic customers hit novel challenges, you'll go hands-on to solve them. And throughout, you'll synthesize what you're learning across customers and products into insights that shape our roadmap, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to stay calibrated on what's working, what's not, and what matters most.

This role is equal parts researcher, field expert, and connective tissue between our customers and the teams that build our products. You'll need the technical depth to push the boundaries of what our models can do, strong communication skills to make complex capabilities clear to diverse audiences, and the instinct to turn what you learn in the field into signal that makes our products better.

Responsibilities:

• Embed with product teams to build deep technical expertise on new products and capabilities as they develop, becoming the field's go-to expert in your domain
• Own the technical<> GTM handshake for model and product launches-- early testing, field readiness assessments, and ongoing capability education throughout the model lifecycle
• Build demos, evals, and prototypes that showcase customer-relevant model and product capabilities, and define what good performance looks like in important domains
• Develop enablement materials like playbooks, training sessions, and reference architectures in partnership with Technical Enablement, so Applied AI teams can effectively position and deliver new capabilities from day one
• Engage hands-on with strategic customers facing novel technical challenges in your domain, discover solutions, then package learnings into scalable approaches for the broader field
• Synthesize insights from across customer engagements and work with Product and Research to land them. Identify adoption patterns, common blockers, and capability gaps that should inform our research and product roadmaps
• Partner with Sales and Applied AI teams to support high-value accounts that need specialized domain knowledge
• Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, implementation support, and research collaboration

You may be a good fit if you have:

• 6+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Technical Product Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer, AI startup founder, or similar technical role -- ideally with some exposure to customers or end users

• A track record of going deep on technical problems and then translating what you learned into materials, training, or tools that helped others succeed
• Strong technical aptitude with strong proficiency in at least one programming language
• Meaningful experience building with large language models -- whether shipping LLM-powered products, developing agents or workflows, or integrating models into production systems
• Experience designing evals, building prototypes, or developing technical enablement for complex products
• The ability to quickly build domain expertise in new product areas and become a credible technical voice on new topics
• Curiosity about what AI models can actually do -- you enjoy probing the edges of new capabilities and figuring out what use cases just unlocked
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders, including exec-level
• The ability to navigate and execute amidst ambiguity, and to flex into different domains based on the business problem at hand, finding simple, easy-to-understand solutions
• A collaborative, service-oriented mindset – go-to-market at Anthropic is a team sport
• Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$300,000—$400,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 身為
資深創作者營運專員（Senior Creator Operations Specialist
）
，您將在台灣市場的創作者生態系發展中扮演關鍵角色，負責創作者招募、活動執行、平台營運及合作夥伴管理等工作。
